channels.name: Network port (Ethernet / UDP)
channels.purpose: Carries PTP event and general messages (Ethernet 0x88F7 or UDP 319/320).

channels.name: Hardware-timestamp capture
channels.purpose: Samples the PTP clock counter on event-message start at the MAC/PHY plane (T1/T2/T3/T4).

global_signals.name: Grandmaster
global_signals.purpose: The BMCA-elected root of the master-slave hierarchy; the time reference for the domain.

handshake_pairs.name: Sync / Follow_Up
handshake_pairs.rule: Sync carries/references T1; two-step Follow_Up carries the precise T1.

handshake_pairs.name: Delay_Req / Delay_Resp
handshake_pairs.rule: Delay_Req (T3) -> Delay_Resp (T4) measures the reverse path.

handshake_pairs.name: Pdelay_Req / Pdelay_Resp
handshake_pairs.rule: Peer delay round measures link delay (t1..t4).

handshake_pairs.name: Announce / BMCA
handshake_pairs.rule: Announce carries clock quality; the BMCA elects the Grandmaster.

dependency_graph.common_rule: The BMCA must elect a master (from Announce messages) before a port slaves. A slave needs both a Sync (T1/T2) and a Delay_Req/Delay_Resp (T3/T4) — or a peer-delay round — to compute offsetFromMaster and meanPathDelay.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: offsetFromMaster depends on T1, T2, T3, T4 and the accumulated correctionField; the servo depends on offsetFromMaster; Transparent-Clock correction depends on the measured residence time.

fields.ic_name: IEEE 1588 Precision Time Protocol (PTP) Clock Synchronization Engine (PTPv2 / IEEE 802.1AS)

ordering_rules.message_order: Sync precedes its Follow_Up (two-step); Delay_Req precedes Delay_Resp; sequenceId orders messages.
ordering_rules.election_order: Announce collection precedes the BMCA decision precedes port-state assignment.
ordering_rules.domain: Messages are processed only within the matching domainNumber.
ordering_rules.transport: Event messages use UDP 319 / Ethernet 0x88F7; general messages use UDP 320 / Ethernet 0x88F7.

ic_name: IEEE 1588 Precision Time Protocol (PTP) Clock Synchronization Engine (PTPv2 / IEEE 802.1AS)
